senses.definition_en: antiparallelogram

examples.english: The quadrilateral is always an antiparallelogram, from where one easily deduces a relation between the distances of the instantaneous center at 0₁, 0₂, A and B.
examples.ref: 1907, José Ruiz-Castizo Ariza, Tratado de mecánica racional apropiado a la enseñanza en las facultades de ciencias y en las escuelas especiales, page 562:
examples.text: El cuadrilátero es siempre un antiparalelogramo, de donde se deduce una relación fácil entre las distancias del centro instantáneo á 0₁, 0₂, A y B.
examples.translation: The quadrilateral is always an antiparallelogram, from where one easily deduces a relation between the distances of the instantaneous center at 0₁, 0₂, A and B.

examples.english: The antiparallelogram makes possible, as we have said, the transformation of a rectilinear movement into a circular one, […]
examples.text: El antiparalelogramo hace posible, como hemos dicho, la transformación de un movimiento rectilineo en otro circular, […]
examples.translation: The antiparallelogram makes possible, as we have said, the transformation of a rectilinear movement into a circular one, […]

examples.english: If figure OO₁BA is an antiparallelogram, two cases must be distinguished, depending on whether the connecting rod is larger than the cranks (fig. 11-V), or whether it is smaller (fig. 12-V).
examples.ref: 1960, Darío Maravall Casesnoves, Mecánica para ingenieros y cálculo tensorial:
examples.text: Si la figura OO₁BA es un antiparalelogramo, hay que distinguir dos casos, según que la biela sea mayor que las manivelas (fig. 11-V), o que sea menor (fig. 12-V).
examples.translation: If figure OO₁BA is an antiparallelogram, two cases must be distinguished, depending on whether the connecting rod is larger than the cranks (fig. 11-V), or whether it is smaller (fig. 12-V).
